Dear Rin Hanasaki, nice to meet you!
My name is Nekomaga Himari, and I am currently a Vtuber, although I am still in the preparation stage.
I got to know you from Proseka's FA and saw your wonderful illustrations, so I sent a request to you to draw one for me!

I would like to send you a request for your drawing.
(Reference material)
https://twitter.com/2Himari2/status/1527408767901519889?s=20&t=phH_YVglmhgb5O9dVfxD3g

Usage.
I would like to use it for promotion in my daily SNS activities and as a thumbnail on YouTube!

About the illustration
The overall atmosphere of the illustration should be cute!
Pose, composition, background, and additional decorations are up to you.
If possible, it would be very helpful if you could draw it so that it extends to the waist or the feet...!

Preferred delivery format
We would appreciate it if you could include the waist or feet in the drawing if possible.
We would appreciate it if you could separate the layers of the background, the person, and the signature, and prepare a transparent version.
I would appreciate it if you could post it on Twitter with the tag #Himari no Sugatami...!

Thank you very much for taking the time to read through this!
Thank you very much for your consideration.
